messages:
Alex: Heads-up — prepping GateFlow joint demo + marketplace listing for NextWeek Summit. Need a short checklist: connector cert, smoke tests, docs, demo runbook, and co-announcement timeline. Who can own what? :eyes:

Priya: I can own the docs and marketplace listing assets. Will spin a draft PR today. PTAL when ready. :white_check_mark:

Mateo: Question — do we have a certification checklist for gateways? Need the test matrix (auth, routing, model variants, scale). If not, I can draft one.

Jin: Quick starter checklist to copy into PR:
- SSO / API key auth verified
- End-to-end request through GateFlow -> Redwood -> model
- Latency smoke (p95 < 300ms for demo model)
- Fallback path validated
- Billing/reporting link hooked to marketplace metadata

And a quick smoke curl to validate end-to-end:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
 -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"hello gateway"}'
```

Rowan: For hardware partners: we need to call out quantized model support and perf envelope in the listing. I can add a short section with quantization footprint and expected throughput.

Casey: Available to own the demo flow and runbook. Thinking: 1) simple chat demo, 2) large-batch embedding pipeline, 3) graceful-degradation scenario. Will record short clip for the Summit booth. :movie_camera:

Sam: Marketing timeline: draft blog + partner quotes by Thu EOD, internal embargo until demo day (NextWeek Wednesday). Need brand assets and a 1-paragraph partner quote from GateFlow legal.

Priya: Opening PR branch partners/gateflow-marketplace. Will include TOC: README, checklist, demo-runbook, assets, announcement copy.

Jin: I'll add CI job to run connector smoke and integration tests. Example run command for the pipeline:```bash
./ci/run_connector_smoke.sh --connector gateflow --model open-llama-7b
```
I'll gate the marketplace listing behind `ci/connector-smoke` passing.

deploy-bot: CI: connector-smoke passed for branch partners/gateflow-marketplace (job #412) :white_check_mark:

Alex: Great. Owners so far — Docs: Priya; Demo/runbook: Casey; Integration tests + test matrix: Mateo & Jin; Quantization/perf: Rowan; Marketing copy: Sam/Taylor. Can we sync in 30m in #partnerships to confirm timelines and get GateFlow on a call?

Casey: SGTM. I'll bring a 5-step demo script and sample recordings.

Mateo: I'll draft the test matrix and post as a checklist item in the PR.

Rowan: I'll attach perf numbers and a short note on recommended quant profiles (int8 vs int4) to the doc.

Taylor: Marketing here — will prep the announcement draft and coordinate asset handoff. Please @me on the PR when copy is ready.

Alex: Thanks all. Priya — bump me once the PR has the announcement copy and checklist so we can loop GateFlow legal. :rocket:
